info.title: Adliance.QmDoc
info.description: Tool to convert documentation and markdown files to pretty-looking PDF (also supports DOCX).

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Runs the Markdown to DOCX conversion. Only supports a subset of features compared to the PDF conversion.

options.name: --theme
options.description:
(Default: ) The name of the theme that should
be used.

options.name: --source
options.description:
(Default: ./) File or directory that
represents the source files.

options.name: --target
options.description:
(Default: ./) Directory to store the resulting
files to.

options.name: --title
options.description:
(Default: ) The title of the document. If
empty, the file name will be used.

options.name: --placeholders
options.description:
(Default: placeholders.json) Path to an
optional JSON file that contains placeholders
to be merged into the resulting document.

options.name: --ignore-git-commits-since
options.description:
Git commits made on or after this date will
not be shown in Git Placeholders (eg.
"2022-12-31").

options.name: --ignore-git-commits
options.description:
A list of Git commit SHAs or parts of Git SHAs
(comma separated) that should not be shown in
Git Placeholders (eg. "d53ba669, b0d71fe388").

options.name: --ignore-git-commits-without
options.description:
A list of words (comma separated). If a commit
message does not contain any of these words,
the Git commit will not be shown in Git
Placeholders (eg. "Freigabe, For Training")

options.name: --include-subdirectories
options.description:
(Default: false) Also looks into all
subdirectories of the source directory for
Markdown files, instead of just the source
directory itself.

options.name: --stdin
options.description:
(Default: false) Reads the Markdown from
standard input instead of the source file.
--source must then be the path of a single
Markdown file; it is used to resolve includes,
images, links and the Git history, but does
not need to exist.

options.name: --stdout
options.description:
(Default: false) Writes the resulting file to
standard output instead of the target
directory. Log messages are written to
standard error instead. Only works for a
single source file.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: html
commands.description: Runs the full Markdown to HTML conversion.

options.name: --source-lines
options.description:
(Default: false) Adds "data-line" attributes
with the (zero-based) line in the source file
to the HTML elements, eg. for scrolling editor
previews to the same position as the editor.
